never_upload: story flags other than unlock checked locally

authentication_contract.sign_in: signInAnonymously once per device/session identity and reuse the authenticated session
authentication_contract.reason: avoid unnecessary anonymous-account creation and same-IP signup pressure

guest_join_sequence: 1. authenticated guest writes guestUid = own auth.uid exactly once
room_contract.activation: either participant may transition WAITING→ACTIVE only after guestUid, both nonces, both parties and both ready=true exist

terminal.ACTIVE_to_FINISHED: participant submits COMPLETE endRequest then status FINISHED
terminal.ACTIVE_to_ABORTED: participant submits non-COMPLETE endRequest then status ABORTED

cleanup.normal_end: participant removes room immediately after FINISHED/ABORTED UI closes
cleanup.presence_disconnect: do not delete room; onDisconnect only marks presence so 30-second reconnect remains possible
cleanup.logical_expiry: writes except deletion are rejected after expiresAt
cleanup.stale_room_physical_cleanup: participant cleans remembered stale room on next launch; fully orphaned room requires periodic admin/trusted-backend cleanup
cleanup.spark_client_only_limit: delayed physical deletion of fully orphaned RTDB nodes cannot be guaranteed by client Security Rules alone

local_preflight: online feature unlock flag is true
selected instanceIds are unique and exist in loaded Save v2
1..4 current move IDs all resolve in Battle v3

server_party_snapshot.member_index: 0..5 session-local index; local instanceId is never uploaded

seed_and_rng_contract.host_nonce: 128-bit random lowercase hex fixed at room creation
seed_and_rng_contract.guest_nonce: 128-bit random lowercase hex fixed at guest join
seed_and_rng_contract.battleSeedU32: unsigned big-endian integer from first 4 digest bytes
seed_and_rng_contract.rule: every random battle decision consumes the shared PRNG only through the central deterministic battle RNG service

phases.client_verification: recompute SHA-256 and compare to commit; mismatch => INVALID_REVEAL abort

phases.rule: both clients independently resolve the turn using Battle v3 and shared PRNG; no authoritative battle state is uploaded

resolution_order: move priority from Battle v3 if present, otherwise 0
all accuracy/critical/damage/secondary random calls through deterministic RNG in engine-defined canonical order
turn_protocol.note: Security Rules enforce own-path append-only writes and commit-before-reveal. Exact sequential turn-number truth remains peer-validated by deterministic clients.

presence_and_reconnect.on_disconnect: server-side onDisconnect sets connected=false and lastSeenAt=serverTimestamp
presence_and_reconnect.resume_rule: same auth.uid reconnecting within 30 seconds resumes current room and replays action log if needed
presence_and_reconnect.timeout_rule: after 30 seconds opponent may submit DISCONNECT_TIMEOUT endRequest and abort room
presence_and_reconnect.web_session_note: RTDB web offline cache is session-scoped; action log replay from server is the reconnect authority

canonical_state_fields: host active member index and each member HP/status/PP
guest active member index and each member HP/status/PP
state_hash_contract.serialization: UTF-8 JSON with fixed key order defined by protocol v1

operational_limits.reason: privacy-preserving no-room-list architecture plus client-only Spark rules do not provide a trustworthy global active-room counter
operational_limits.launch_monitoring: measure RTDB bandwidth/connections and adjust operational target after classroom/tablet load test

server_enforced: reveal blocked until both commits exist
state ACK blocked until both reveals exist
room expiry and terminal deletion rules
peer_verified: party move IDs resolve against bundled Battle v3
not_server_verifiable_v1: submitted party truly came from the player's local Save v2
submitted levels/moves were not locally modified before upload
COMPLETE/DISCONNECT_TIMEOUT/STALL end reason truth; peers can abort falsely, but no ranked/reward/save effect exists
threat_model.risk_acceptance: v1 is private friend battle with no rank, rewards, EXP, item, dex or story effect; server-authoritative anti-cheat is intentionally out of scope

firebase_implementation_notes.use_runTransaction: optional for local counters only; room creation uses high-entropy code + create-if-absent Security Rule, avoiding need to read/list /rooms
firebase_implementation_notes.anonymous_auth_classroom_note: reuse anonymous session; test many devices behind one school/NAT IP because Firebase may rate-limit bursts of new anonymous signups
